candidates.label: Racial and gendered power in global social relations

assessment: All59 target-linked rows reconciled:13direct generators,29support topics,6illustrations and11conditional outcomes. Five generators are substantively owned by the closest concept, including the urban-place question as a core inquiry with an explicit dedicated-course limitation; four generate institutional/collective responses, four generate race/gender/global relations. No inherited split-target premise, career entitlement or omnibus residual candidate is used.

sourceSupport.20499–20511: Sociology/inequality, individuals/structures, institutions/change, migration/diversity, racism/gender/globalisation and social research are corroborated by the actual compulsory units and public themes. Urban identity is a genuine target interest, but not a false dedicated UCR urban-sociology claim.
sourceSupport.20512–20540: Current theory, domains, methods and craft corroborate support topics. Row20535 is corrected from unsupported social-network analysis to the actually evidenced social-network theory, with current course-specific evidence/source. The former analysis premise is removed from decision basis/candidate/alternative evidence. The operational review index is refreshed; no final discovery publication is authorised.
sourceSupport.20541–20557: Six public illustrations and eleven possible study/research/professional outcomes remain search-only and conditional; neither course construction nor future admission/employment is inferred from them.

candidateReassessment.closest: Full five-course UCR sociology sequence, qualitative research and statistical/econometric/data, health, historical, organisational and institutional inquiry implement a substantial sociological response. Public Policy replaces Peace/Conflict here to strengthen a compulsory target domain while that conflict course remains purposeful in other options.
candidateReassessment.institutions: Coherent collective decisions, distribution, policy, law/rights and communication. Public Economics replaces consumer-product design; law is property/tort/contract rather than invented housing/family content.
candidateReassessment.global: Coherent race/gender, globalisation and migration/diversity interests support global social relations through sociology, imperial/Indigenous/gender histories, media/race and international institutions. Narrowed label/concept to actual substance: no dedicated migration, urban or citizenship sequence is claimed. Youth Resilience contributes educational inclusion and civic agency specifically, not generic political psychology. A sustainability partner project is replaced by global public-policy analysis.
